routines.name: command_group_primary
routines.purpose: Membership in the first-priority command group (42 table entries).

routines.name: command_group_secondary
routines.purpose: Membership in the second-priority command group (41 entries).

routines.name: command_group_fallback
routines.purpose: Membership in the final command group (12 entries).

routines.name: command_fallback_stub
routines.purpose: Selected fallback handler in this image returns zero.

routines.name: command_router
routines.purpose: Selector 0xcc dispatch; command byte at 0x47eb80 + slot * 128 + 2.

routines.name: xor_bytes
routines.purpose: XOR byte accumulator; nonpositive signed lengths return zero.

routines.name: plane_copy_and_xor
routines.purpose: Copy three 320-byte source planes into RAM and store their XOR checksum.

routines.name: plane_write_byte
routines.purpose: Write low byte of r5 only when unsigned plane r3 <= 2 and offset r4 <= 319.

routines.name: plane_record_offset
routines.purpose: Return low 16 bits of index * 970 plus uint16 at 0x340000.

routines.name: secondary_dispatch_frame
routines.purpose: Secondary dispatcher entry, default handler and shared epilogue; other switch bodies are separate fragments.

routines.name: command_32_write_planes
routines.purpose: Command 0x32 body: write supplied bytes through plane bounds helper; return XOR of all supplied bytes in response halfword.

routines.name: packet_selector_entry
routines.purpose: Parent dispatcher entry; selector from slot byte 1, command from byte 2. Selector cc/f0/f1 branches to router call fragment.

routines.name: packet_selector_return
routines.purpose: Parent dispatcher router call and common saved-register epilogue.

routines.name: register_read8
routines.purpose: Logical register byte read; optional page-selection write.

routines.name: register_write8
routines.purpose: Logical register byte write; optional page selection and multi-target mask path.

routines.name: register_update_bits
routines.purpose: Masked bit set/clear with polling and nesting counter; store width remains unresolved.

routines.name: register_read16
routines.purpose: Read high byte then low byte through the register byte helper.

routines.name: register_write16
routines.purpose: Write low byte then tail-call byte writer for the high byte.

routines.name: slot_buffer_offset
routines.purpose: Mode-dependent buffer offsets for slots 0,1,2,3,7; other IDs return 0xb900.

routines.name: slot_ring_position
routines.purpose: Per-slot halfword read from the initialized register base.

routines.name: slot_control_or08
routines.purpose: Set bit 3 in the slot control byte; peripheral semantics unknown.

routines.name: slot_control_or30
routines.purpose: Set bits 4 and 5 in the slot control byte.

routines.name: slot_status40
routines.purpose: Return bit 6 of the slot control byte.

routines.name: slot_status80
routines.purpose: Return bit 7 of the slot control byte.

routines.name: slot_frame_status
routines.purpose: Return the slot-specific frame status bit.

routines.name: slot_event_or
routines.purpose: OR low byte of r4 into a slot event-related register.

routines.name: slot_data_write
routines.purpose: Write low byte of r4 to the slot data register.

routines.name: slot_control_or04
routines.purpose: Set bit 2 in the slot control byte.

routines.name: slot_event_read
routines.purpose: Read the slot event-related byte.

routines.name: slot_data_read
routines.purpose: Read the slot data register.

routines.name: slot_state_initialize
routines.purpose: Clear eight five-byte records, eight flags and two global bytes.

routines.name: slot_state_clear
routines.purpose: Clear slot state and received byte count; no slot bound in this routine.

routines.name: slot_packet_xor
routines.purpose: XOR slot bytes with seed 0x3e; caller must bound length.

routines.name: slot_transfer_service
routines.purpose: Receive/transmit ring state machine; execution incomplete because of unresolved stores and peripheral calls.

routines.name: indirect_buffer_read8
routines.purpose: Indirect byte read with bounded busy polls and retry flag; masked-update dependency has unresolved store width.

routines.name: slot_lookup_channel
routines.purpose: Return first matching channel-table index for slot+1; sentinel 6 when absent.

routines.name: slot_followup
routines.purpose: Copy received frame to shadow buffer, format response, prepare transmit and write final marker.

routines.name: indirect_buffer_write8
routines.purpose: Indirect byte write with busy polling and masked-update dependency; store semantics unresolved.

routines.name: indirect_buffer_write32_reverse
routines.purpose: Write r3 bytes from least to most significant at descending indirect addresses 0x4fff..0x4ffc.

routines.name: memory_copy
routines.purpose: Forward copy using aligned words and byte remainder; overlap is not handled as memmove.

routines.name: slot_response_format
routines.purpose: Format selector-1/3 responses and update mirrored settings; bg.sh address lane unresolved.

routines.name: slot_transmit_prepare
routines.purpose: Add header/checksum, set transmit metadata, queue initial bytes and arm slot control.

routines.name: slot_wait_and_clear
routines.purpose: Poll slot state with up to twenty calls to an unresolved delay helper, then clear it.

routines.name: timer_tick
routines.purpose: Decrement counters, set periodic flags, and dispatch channel callbacks; tick period and interrupt source unknown.

routines.name: nop_return
routines.purpose: Observed nop and return; no calibrated delay established.

routines.name: delay_wait
routines.purpose: Arm a halfword-load counter and poll adjacent completion flag; store width unresolved.

routines.name: delay_wait_with_callback
routines.purpose: Optionally call pointer at 0x4824ac before arming the shared delay counter and waiting.

routines.name: timer_initialize
routines.purpose: Clear periodic flag and initialize reload counter to 1000; physical units unknown.

routines.name: nop_repeat
routines.purpose: Call nop-return low-byte(argument) times, preserving r10; not a calibrated delay.

routines.name: callback_set
routines.purpose: Store r4 at callback_table + uint32(r3<<2), with no local index bound.

routines.name: callback_clear
routines.purpose: Clear ten callback table entries.

routines.name: channel_record_set34
routines.purpose: Write low byte r4 at 0x4821ec + uint32(r3*168) + 0x34; physical meaning unknown.

routines.name: callback_initialize
routines.purpose: Call external configuration helper, clear callbacks, install seven entries and enable callback gating.

routines.name: timer_register
routines.purpose: Pass timer_dispatch and Check timer string to timer_create_wrapper with arguments 0,1,1.

routines.name: timer_dispatch
routines.purpose: Call timer_tick then maintain word counters, divide-by-100 byte counter, and divide-by-1000 counter.

routines.name: timer_create_wrapper
routines.purpose: Create candidate timer handle and configure it through four external functions; timing units unknown.

routines.name: channel_layout_configure
routines.purpose: Select one of six rectangle layouts, clear four channel records, configure active records and call external apply routine.

routines.name: channel_record_configure
routines.purpose: Populate channel record with two copies of four packed halfwords and flags; wide store semantics conditional.

routines.name: channel_record_reset
routines.purpose: Reset selected fields of a 168-byte channel record; not a full memset; wide store semantics conditional.

routines.name: channel_record_set95
routines.purpose: Write low byte r4 to channel record offset 0x95.

routines.name: layout_size_first
routines.purpose: Return 1344/1536/1728/1920 for selector 0/1/2/3, otherwise zero.

routines.name: layout_size_second
routines.purpose: Return 756/864/972/1080 for selector 0/1/2/3, otherwise zero.

routines.name: channel_layout_apply
routines.purpose: Apply orchestration: external setup, four engine calls, then three record flags and mask-selected rectangle copies; hardware dependencies unexecuted.

routines.name: channel_source_switch
routines.purpose: Guard source selector <=5 and nonzero record masks before switching through external services.

routines.name: engine_prepare
routines.purpose: Reject engine indices >3; otherwise external setup and conditional state handling.

routines.name: channel_update_range
routines.purpose: Selector4 chooses record range0..3, otherwise one record; clear byte0x5b and combine external service results.

routines.name: channel_metadata_reset
routines.purpose: External preparation then selective reset of six 176-byte metadata records with per-record external calls.

routines.name: configuration_poll_wait
routines.purpose: Conditional two-phase poll using countdown0x455208; configuration bit0x20 or inactive flag bypasses polling.

routines.name: channel_mask_prepare
routines.purpose: Iterate selected engine bits, consult channel metadata, and dispatch register preparation; physical effects unverified.

routines.name: register_mask_write8
routines.purpose: Read-modify-write byte as (old & ~mask) | (value & mask), with lock and unresolved counter-store semantics.

routines.name: register_mask_write16
routines.purpose: Two masked byte updates for low and high halves; conditional store semantics inherited from byte helper.

routines.name: engine_geometry_service
routines.purpose: Metadata/configuration guards and engine mode service after rectangle copy; external services and full execution unverified.

routines.name: channel_source_read
routines.purpose: Read byte at channel record base0x4821ec + index*168 +0x28; no local bound.

routines.name: engine_channel_read
routines.purpose: Read byte at engine record base0x47fa9c + index*124 +0x10; no local bound.

routines.name: engine_metadata_read
routines.purpose: Read metadata index byte at engine record base0x47fa9c + index*124 +0x1d; no local bound.

routines.name: metadata_engine_read
routines.purpose: Read byte at metadata base0x3b4950 + index*176 +0x10; no local bound.

routines.name: metadata_mask_read
routines.purpose: Read low halfword at metadata base0x3b4950 + index*176 +0x12; halfword semantics assumed.

routines.name: engine_mask_register_write
routines.purpose: Map engine to metadata key and select paged register bank, then write the supplied 16-bit mask.

routines.name: engine_mask_register_update
routines.purpose: Map engine to metadata key and mask-update selected 16-bit paged register; zero argument sets bits, nonzero clears.

routines.name: channel_selector_mask
routines.purpose: Table-dispatched selector:0->0x80,1..7->1<<(index-1),larger uint32->0; physical channel meaning unknown.

routines.name: metadata_state_accumulate
routines.purpose: Accumulate flag-selected channel bits in global state and dispatch common services; both enable and disable paths call services.

routines.name: metadata_state_publish
routines.purpose: Store two state values and OR flag0x4543dd with2; wide-store semantics conditional.

routines.name: metadata_state_publish_jump
routines.purpose: Tail jump to shared metadata state publication routine.

routines.name: metadata_state_store
routines.purpose: Store low bytes of three arguments at globals 0x454160..162.

routines.name: metadata_state_combine
routines.purpose: Combine accumulated metadata bytes and tail-call the three-byte state store.

routines.name: channel_state_configure
routines.purpose: Publish six argument bytes and write four per-channel state words selected by low mask bits.

routines.name: channel_state_configure_jump
routines.purpose: Tail jump to channel state configuration.

routines.name: channel_enable_dispatch
routines.purpose: Dispatch each of four low mask bits to the channel enable register helper.

routines.name: channel_enable_dispatch_jump
routines.purpose: Tail jump to four-channel enable dispatch.

routines.name: metadata_register_apply
routines.purpose: Conditionally publish two bytes, then update selected register bits through two helpers.

routines.name: metadata_register_apply_jump
routines.purpose: Tail jump to metadata register application.

routines.name: channel_state_notify_return
routines.purpose: Archived single return instruction called from channel state configuration; no additional effects.

routines.name: channel_register_bank_offset
routines.purpose: Map indices 1/2/3 to 0x300/0x800/0xb00, all other uint32 values to0.

routines.name: channel_enable_registers
routines.purpose: Store enable byte and update two masked register fields; register meaning and ISA assumptions unresolved.

routines.name: metadata_register_mask40
routines.purpose: Clear bit0x40 in three logical registers, then set selected bits from input mask0x70.

routines.name: metadata_register_mask01
routines.purpose: Set bit0 in selected registers and accumulate corresponding low bits at an argument pointer.

routines.name: engine_records_initialize
routines.purpose: Initialize selected records among thirteen stride124 records, optionally configure register paths, then prepare masks.

routines.name: auxiliary_records_reset
routines.purpose: Reset selected low four mask bits in stride24 records using an eight-byte template.

routines.name: engine_range_configure
routines.purpose: Derive start/end values and route four word writes plus a control-bit update according to engine parity and mode.

routines.name: engine_control_configure
routines.purpose: Coordinate engine control, metadata gates and register updates; several dependencies remain unrecovered.

routines.name: register_write32
routines.purpose: Write four low-to-high bytes at consecutive logical register addresses.

routines.name: register_deferred_write32
routines.purpose: Split a word into aligned mask/value requests to unresolved service0x27b707.

routines.name: register_deferred_write8
routines.purpose: Align a byte request into a masked halfword request to unresolved service0x27b707.

routines.name: register_deferred_update_bits
routines.purpose: Read byte, set or clear selected bits, then submit a deferred masked write.

routines.name: engine_metadata_control_mask_lookup
routines.purpose: Map metadata index 0..5 to a uint32 metadata key; key 0..8 returns a logical base value, otherwise zero.

routines.name: engine_control_metadata_flags_apply
routines.purpose: Read metadata flags and write 0x80 to engine control registers at offsets 0x0f/0x11 for selected flag values.

routines.name: engine_control_metadata_mask20_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, masked-update control register offset 0x90 with mask 0x20.

routines.name: engine_control_metadata_mask10_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, masked-update control register offset 0x90 with mask 0x10.

routines.name: engine_control_channel_mask08_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, choose control offset 0x90 or 0x02800090 from channel parity and masked-update bit 3.

routines.name: engine_control_mode_bits_write
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, write two mode bits through the control register at offset 0x90.

routines.name: engine_control_bit01_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, masked-update control register offset 0x90 with mask 0x01.

routines.name: engine_control_bit40_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, masked-update control register offset 0x90 with mask 0x40.

routines.name: engine_register_bit04_read
routines.purpose: Read engine register offset 0x42 and return bit 4.

routines.name: engine_register_value45_read
routines.purpose: Read and return engine register offset 0x45.

routines.name: engine_register_bit08_read
routines.purpose: Read engine register offset 0x43 and return bit 3.

routines.name: engine_register_bit40_read
routines.purpose: Read engine register offset 0x06 and return bit 6.

routines.name: engine_register_word0e_read
routines.purpose: Read engine halfword offset 0x0e and mask to 15 bits.

routines.name: engine_register_word0c_read
routines.purpose: Read engine halfword offset 0x0c and mask to 13 bits.

routines.name: engine_register_word08_read
routines.purpose: Read engine halfword offset 0x08 and mask to 13 bits.

routines.name: engine_register_value3d_read
routines.purpose: Read and return engine register offset 0x3d.

routines.name: engine_register_flag41_test
routines.purpose: Read engine register offset 0x41 and return its sign bit; parity paths implement the same test.

routines.name: engine_register_flag07_write
routines.purpose: Write 0x80 or zero to engine register offset 0x07 according to the first argument.

routines.name: engine_control_flag05_mask_update
routines.purpose: For each selected engine bit, masked-update engine register offset 0x05 with mask 0x04.

routines.name: engine_register_value04_read
routines.purpose: Read and return engine register offset 0x04.

routines.name: engine_control_geometry_size_calculate
routines.purpose: Derive a 16-bit size from engine register offset 0x50 and metadata bytes at offsets 0x88/0x89.

routines.name: engine_metadata_control_update_dispatch
routines.purpose: Dispatch metadata values 0..8 through a second table to masked control-register updates; unsupported values return without update.

routines.name: engine_mask_enable
routines.purpose: Read the engine-bank word at offset 4, then set or clear mask 2 at logical address 0x10800032 + bank according to odd or even bank parity.

routines.name: channel_reference_count
routines.purpose: Count matching active channels and return the resulting count.

routines.name: metadata_word6c_read
routines.purpose: Read a 32-bit word from the metadata structure at offset 0x6c.

routines.name: metadata_word0c_zero_test
routines.purpose: Test whether the 32-bit metadata word at offset 0x0c is zero.

routines.name: metadata_state_write_selected_engines
routines.purpose: Write a metadata state value and apply it to selected engine records at word offset 0x08.

routines.name: metadata_flag_read_1
routines.purpose: For metadata indices 0..5, require a nonzero halfword at metadata offset 0xac, then return bit 3 of byte offset 0x98.

routines.name: metadata_flag_read_2
routines.purpose: For metadata indices 0..5, require a nonzero halfword at metadata offset 0xac, then return bit 5 of byte offset 0x98.

routines.name: metadata_flag_read_3
routines.purpose: Walk stride-0xb0 records; for type 4 with a nonzero halfword at metadata base offset 0xac (base+0xa0 plus 0x0c), subtract 50 decimal from that halfword.

routines.name: broadcast_mask_counter_store
routines.purpose: Store the supplied value at fixed address 0x455214 when the selector is nonzero, otherwise store zero; semantics are unknown.

routines.name: global_halfword_read
routines.purpose: Read and return a global halfword.

routines.name: register_pair_configuration
routines.purpose: Configure a pair of registers from the supplied values; register semantics are unresolved.

routines.name: channel_metadata_update
routines.purpose: Update channel metadata flags using the metadata index and channel record.

routines.name: channel_metadata_bit_update
routines.purpose: Allocate and mark channel metadata ownership, then call the channel helper.

routines.name: channel_overlap_flags_update
routines.purpose: Update channel overlap flags 0x35 and 0x36.

routines.name: engine_pair01_available
routines.purpose: Return whether engine register pair 0x01 is available.

routines.name: engine_pair23_available
routines.purpose: Return whether engine register pair 0x23 is available.

routines.name: channel_record_rectangle_assign
routines.purpose: Assign the selected channel rectangle using the requested engine and record.

routines.name: engine_free_index_scan
routines.purpose: Scan engine records and return a free engine index, if found.

routines.name: channel_update_range_check
routines.purpose: Check channel records in the selected range and apply range-update helpers.

routines.name: channel_update_range_apply
routines.purpose: Apply the requested update across channel records in the selected range.

routines.name: constant_one_return
routines.purpose: Return the constant value 1.

routines.purpose: Tail-transfer to the existing request service at 0x27aa7f.

routines.name: deferred_halfword_request
routines.purpose: Prepare a deferred halfword request, then tail-transfer to the request service.

routines.name: engine_pair_configuration
routines.purpose: Prepare the selected engine-pair state and preserve its original service calls.

routines.name: engine_mode_configuration
routines.purpose: Configure engine mode through indexed branches and register requests; external services remain unresolved.

routines.name: engine_mode_reset
routines.purpose: Set global mode parameters, invoke the mode routine, and update engine state.

routines.name: engine_mode_apply_wrapper
routines.purpose: Invoke the engine-mode routine for indices 0 through 12.

routines.purpose: Execute ambiguous bg.sh store relative to global 0x343c14; width/lane policies remain unresolved.

routines.purpose: Execute ambiguous bg.sw_1 store relative to global 0x343c14; width/lane policies remain unresolved.

routines.purpose: Read a halfword from global address 0x343c16.

routines.purpose: Read one channel record's halfword field and pass it to a helper; the helper's physical meaning is unresolved.

routines.name: channel_storage_configuration
routines.purpose: Configure channel storage records through indexed branches, helper calls, and memory writes; external services remain unresolved.

routines.name: channel_storage_register_setup
routines.purpose: Initialize register fields and configure them from ENGINE-pair records at 0x47faa0 and 0x47fb98; bus and device behavior remain unresolved.

routines.purpose: Return zero for zero input, otherwise return the index of the lowest set bit; the storage configuration caller's zero case remains ambiguous.

routines.purpose: Assign a channel from metadata and ENGINE records; helper and dispatch behavior remains unresolved.

routines.purpose: Map metadata state values 2 and 4 to ENGINE state values 5 and 2, otherwise 1.

routines.name: channel_assignment_dispatch
routines.purpose: Prepare dispatch arguments, call helpers, then tail-dispatch to 0x226bb5.

routines.purpose: Route a channel key from metadata to the selector; tail target is 0x23ddb9.

routines.purpose: Apply channel dispatch state; helper behavior at 0x21be27 and 0x21dcee remains unresolved; tail target is 0x23dfb6.

routines.purpose: Read the engine selector byte and return bits 2..6; unsupported engine indices return 0x1f.

routines.purpose: Dispatch a selected metadata key through nine absolute targets; valid cases tail through 0x23ddb9.

routines.name: wide_unsigned_divide

routines.name: wide_multiply
routines.purpose: Modulo-64-bit product of two 64-bit operands, reconstructed from partial-product operations.

routines.purpose: Apply selector masked update with mask 0x01.

routines.purpose: Apply selector masked update with mask 0x18.
